'''Idolian fever''' was a little known disease which [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were able to contract. Nearly twenty years after the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Doan]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] contracted this mysterious illness, prompting [[Gerran's father|his father]] to contact the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]], [[Serra]], to cure him. She nursed Gerran back to health over the course of three months and by that time, the two had fallen in love. The two married and Serra became the Princess of Doan.
